notes.title: A Scarlet Way Playtest Begins
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, players![/p][p]The playtest for [i]A Scarlet Way[/i] starts tomorrow!
If you haven’t signed up yet — now is the perfect time to do so and be among the first to try the game![/p][p][b]Here’s what you need to know before jumping in:[/b][/p][p]Players who participate in the playtest and share their feedback via our form will:[/p][list][*][p]Receive an exclusive in-game reward when the full game is released;[/p][/*][*][p]Be credited in the game as a thank you for helping us improve.[/p][/*][/list][p]Please note that this is a test of an early version of the game focused on the combat system. As such:[/p][list][*][p]Visuals and audio are temporary and do not represent final quality;[/p][/*][*][p]Optimization may vary depending on your device;[/p][/*][*][p]Available features are limited.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your interest in [i]A Scarlet Way[/i]!
Your support means the world to us![/p][p][/p][p][i]Join our public communities to get the latest news first and stay directly in touch with us:[/i][/p][list][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2FNotFriendlyGam1&snr=1_5_9_"]X[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FsHr44ABFMS&snr=1_5_9_"]Discord[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2F%40notfriendlygames1668&snr=1_5_9_"]Youtube[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fvk.com%2Fa_scarlet_way&snr=1_5_9_"]VK[/url][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: The First Public Playtest of A Scarlet Way!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello, players![/h3][p]We’re launching our [b]first public playtest on Steam[/b], and anyone can join!
You can already request access on the game’s main Steam page.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Playtest starts:[/b] [i]July 15, 2025[/i]
[b]Playtest ends:[/b] [i]July 31, 2025[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101843/22df3aa07f2227d054113290df1bd62294ec9587.png"][/img][/p][h3]Goals of the playtest:[/h3][list][*][p]Fine-tune the combat system to make it as satisfying and fun as possible — while keeping it challenging[/p][/*][*][p]Gather feedback on control feel and responsiveness[/p][/*][*][p]Understand how you experience the overall gameplay dynamics[/p][/*][/list][h3]What’s not ready yet:[/h3][list][*][p]All visual elements (environment, UI, animations) and sound effects are [b]temporary[/b] and [b]do not reflect the final quality[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Performance optimization is still in progress[/p][/*][*][p]Game balance is not final[/p][/*][/list][h3]Why you should join:[/h3][list][*][p]You’ll have a chance to directly influence the game’s development[/p][/*][*][p]Your feedback will help us improve the experience and shape the game’s direction[/p][/*][*][p]You'll receive a [b]unique reward[/b] at launch ([i]we won’t spoil what it is yet — mostly because we haven’t decided either 😄[/i])[/p][/*][/list][p]We welcome everyone — see you in the playtest![/p][p][/p][p][i]Join our public communities to get the latest news first and stay directly in touch with us:[/i][/p][list][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2FNotFriendlyGam1&snr=1_5_9_"]X[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FsHr44ABFMS&snr=1_5_9_"]Discord[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2F%40notfriendlygames1668&snr=1_5_9_"]Youtube[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fvk.com%2Fa_scarlet_way&snr=1_5_9_"]VK[/url][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: A Scarlet Way at Comic Con
notes.notes: [p]From July 9 to 13, our team will take part in Comic Con Astana 2025 as part of the video game showcase.[/p][p]Festival visitors will get a chance to try a closed demo version of the game, ask us questions, grab some exclusive merch, and share their feedback and suggestions (which we definitely review — and sometimes even implement!).[/p][p]Come visit us![/p][p][/p][p][i]Join our public communities to be the first to hear about the latest news and stay directly connected with us:[/i][/p][list][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2FNotFriendlyGam1"]X[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FsHr44ABFMS"]Discord[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2F%40notfriendlygames1668"]Youtube[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fvk.com%2Fa_scarlet_way"]VK[/url][/p][/*][/list]
